scope_limits: No original competition source, test or Attachment3/4 contents, history sample CSV, credentials, native journals, real fixed-host campaign ledger or official optimizer path was accessed by the reviewer.

Official-source fingerprint was checked as configuration/instruction provenance only; reviewer did not rehash original data. Synthetic adapter/hash-order fixtures do not establish original-data predictive results.

The101 tests include real CPU synthetic optimizer/checkpoint operations and mocked official scheduling. They are engineering tests, not competition model experiments. Actual CUDA execution, resource profiling, the full322-test suite and live remote preflight were not rerun here.

Review is source-bound technical evidence. Activation publication/safety/clean remote-equal HEAD and fresh unused-campaign preflight must still succeed before the separately preauthorized launch. No campaign was claimed by the reviewer.

Authorization trusts the local OS account and Git publisher. It is not a security sandbox against malicious same-account Python, monkeypatches or deliberate false data_kind labels in private library calls. The supported CLI has no such grant bypass.

Inner deadline checks are cooperative between batches/operations. A hung CUDA/filesystem/network operation or forced termination can leave an incomplete final event/summary; last durable checkpoints and one-use claim remain. An optimizer_started marker proves an attempted optimizer path, not successful parameter updates.
